goalMetric: Weekly anonymous sessions that complete a correct result and continue into at least one connected tool without re-entry
activationMetric: New visitor completes one full public tool without authentication
approvalBoundary: BUILD_AUTHORIZED by Isaac on 2026-09-11 for all eight researched public tools; RELEASE_ACCEPTED is reserved for independent deployed verification
contractPrecedence: current source is evidence, not specification

constraints.anonymousCore: No login, email, payment, or cookie gate for a core result, export, share, or local restore
constraints.completeLoop: A route, form, API, engine, or unit test alone is not a built tool; browser input-to-result-to-persistence-to-handoff must work
constraints.deterministic: AI cannot invent or modify chemical, financial, date, sizing, or purchasing quantities
constraints.precision: Full internal precision; rounding only for display/export
constraints.context: Versioned Recipe/Batch Context transfers reviewed editable fields without personal data
constraints.chemistry: Public chemistry fails closed until source, fixture, domain and safety receipts pass
constraints.money: One currency per calculation; mixed currencies block
constraints.claims: No unverified safety, cure, compliance, source, competitor, or business claim
constraints.release: No product completion claim before Gate_A receives RELEASE_ACCEPTED

capabilities.name: Formulation and lye calculator
acceptanceRows: Anonymous user can enter one or more versioned oils and an explicit positive target oil mass; no hidden default recipe participates in calculation
User can select NaOH, KOH, or mixed alkali; mixed KOH percentage is a share of full pure alkali equivalents
One recipe-level superfat multiplier is applied before independent NaOH and KOH purity corrections
Exactly one water mode controls water and inactive water fields cannot affect output
Result shows oil weights, pure and as-supplied alkalis, water, fragrance/additives, total mass, units, formula version and dataset revision
Show-the-math explains equations and names source status without presenting estimates as authoritative chemistry
Sourced fatty-acid indicators are shown only when data supports them; arbitrary property bands and oil-level IFRA logic are absent
Unknown, conflicted or unverified production ingredient records block with a typed unavailable result
While release receipts are incomplete the public API fails closed and the page truthfully explains the gate without returning quantities
Synthetic NaOH, KOH, mixed, purity, superfat, all-water-mode, unit and deterministic-repeat fixtures pass
A release-enabled deployed browser run completes formulation and transfers reviewed editable context to another tool

capabilities.name: Mold volume and capacity calculator
acceptanceRows: User can calculate normalized volume from rectangular, cylindrical, measured-fill or irregular/measured inputs in metric or imperial units
Fill percentage/headspace is explicit and validated
Calibrated mode requires prior occupied volume and prior batter mass and returns user-specific density and precise target batter mass
Uncalibrated mode returns an explicitly approximate planning range with assumption provenance, never a universal point estimate
Imported recipe context produces an unrounded scale factor and every dependent amount is recomputed from source precision
Optional bar/cut inputs report whole bars and disclosed remainder without counting waste as saleable units
Invalid dimensions, calibration, density or fill values preserve inputs and block output
Geometry, calibration, range, unit-equivalence, irregular, multi-mold and reverse-scaling fixtures pass
Browser result supports local restore, print/export/share and reviewed handoff to recipe scaling

capabilities.name: Recipe scaling calculator
acceptanceRows: User explicitly chooses proportional-copy or formulation-recalculation mode
Copy mode calculates one scale factor and multiplies each unrounded source line once
Formulation mode scales oil percentages to target oil mass then recomputes alkali and water through the canonical chemistry engine
UI does not present proportional copying of chemically incomplete lye/water values as a verified formulation
Target may come from total mass, target oil mass, calibrated mold context or saleable-unit plan when required inputs exist
Result shows source total, target total, scale factor, exact line amounts, units, assumptions and revision
Scale up, scale down, no-op, decimal, unit, sum-invariant and cumulative-rounding fixtures pass
Zero, negative, non-finite or incompatible-unit input blocks and preserves values
Browser result restores locally, exports/shares and transfers editable quantities to costing and purchasing

capabilities.name: Batch costing and cost-per-bar calculator
acceptanceRows: User can enter or import ingredient quantities and purchase cost basis plus packaging, labor and overhead lines
Every required cost line has a complete or named missing basis; missing cost never silently becomes zero
User enters made units and separately identifies trim, samples, defects and retained testing units
Result shows ingredient, packaging, labor, overhead and applicable fee subtotals and total batch cost
Cost per made unit and cost per saleable unit use distinct visible denominators
Saleable units cannot be zero or negative and exclusions cannot exceed made units
When price exists, markup and gross margin are calculated and labelled separately
Mixed currencies block all totals
Complete/incomplete basis, yield loss, labor, overhead, markup/margin and currency fixtures pass in engine and API
Browser result restores locally, prints/exports/shares and transfers basis to wholesale/event planning without email capture

capabilities.name: Wholesale pricing calculator
acceptanceRows: Canonical page exists and does not redirect or rely on an orphan form
User enters/imports cost per saleable unit and chooses target markup or target gross margin as separate modes
Percentage and fixed per-unit channel fees are solved algebraically rather than approximated with a markup multiplier
Impossible margin/fee denominators block with an explanatory field error
Incomplete imported cost basis remains incomplete and cannot be presented as a recommended price
Result shows price, gross profit, achieved markup, achieved gross margin and assumptions
MOQ, order quantity and pack/case multiple produce valid rounded quantities and order totals
Printable/downloadable quote includes currency, revision, assumptions and generated date
Markup, margin, fee, impossible percentage, incomplete basis and MOQ fixtures pass in engine, API and browser

capabilities.name: Craft-fair break-even calculator
acceptanceRows: User enters itemized fixed event costs and zero total fixed cost is valid
User can enter one or more products with price, variable cost, fees, expected mix, stock and sell-through
Result shows per-product contribution and normalized weighted contribution
Break-even and target-profit units use ceiling and show the equation
Result allocates recommended stock by product and discloses projected sold and unsold units under sell-through assumptions
Non-positive weighted contribution blocks rather than producing infinity or a recommendation
Insufficient stock or unrealistic mix creates a visible feasibility warning
Single/multi-product, mix, zero-cost, fees, target profit, sell-through and ceiling fixtures pass
Browser result supports imported pricing context, local restore and export/share

capabilities.name: Ready-by production planner
acceptanceRows: Canonical page is functional and does not redirect to the tool directory
User enters ready-by date, cure interval, unmold/cut/packing buffers and allowed production days
User enters/imports target saleable units, saleable units per batch and production capacity
Planner returns batches required and explicit pour, unmold, cut, estimated-window-reached, packing and ready dates
Date arithmetic uses date-only semantics and is stable across timezone and daylight-saving changes
Blackout dates and capacity constraints are respected
Infeasible plans show required rate and conflict rather than silently scheduling impossible work
Copy says estimated window reached and never declares cure or product safety
Leap/month boundary, ceiling, blackout, capacity and timezone fixtures pass
Browser result restores locally, exports and transfers planned batches to purchasing

capabilities.name: Ingredient purchase planner
acceptanceRows: Canonical page is functional and does not redirect to the tool directory
User enters/imports one or more planned recipes/batches and quantities are normalized before aggregation
Usable stock subtracts reserved stock and net requirement cannot be negative
Optional waste/buffer applies once and its assumption is visible
Supplier packs use ceiling and show purchased amount and overbuy/remainder
Supplier comparison uses landed cost including stated shipping/fees and one currency
Mixed currencies block comparison and totals
Output names unresolved supplier/cost basis and does not invent a preferred supplier
Aggregation, stock, reserved, pack, overbuy, minimum-order, landed-cost and currency fixtures pass
Browser output restores locally and prints/exports a purchase list without claiming inventory depletion

capabilities.name: Recipe/Batch Context and anonymous continuity
acceptanceRows: One versioned schema represents formulation, sizing, yield, cost, pricing, event, production and purchasing context
Each tool declares imported and exported fields and the destination shows field source before user acceptance
Inherited fields remain editable and destination calculation uses its canonical current engine
Formula and dataset revisions survive transfer; mismatch requires explicit migration/recalculation
Local save state is truthful and survives reload; reset is confirmed
Share payload contains no personal data, is validated and checksummed, and opens in a clean browser
Oversized share state offers a portable download instead of producing a broken URL
Corrupt or incompatible context fails safely without executing or silently dropping data

capabilities.name: Homepage and eight-tool directory
acceptanceRows: Homepage and /tools expose exactly the eight in-scope canonical tools with truthful availability
Every directory entry names the user decision, required inputs and connected next step
Every listed route returns its complete tool or truthful chemistry gate; no empty, retired or fictional route
Desktop and narrow mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow and all primary controls meet touch targets
Navigation, footer and primary calls to action contain no subscription, CRM or retired tool promise

capabilities.name: Methodology and source documentation
acceptanceRows: Each tool documents equations, units, assumptions, limitations and revision history
Externally sourced data identifies source, revision/effective date, conflict disposition and eligibility
Methodology does not use disclaimers to cover missing correctness
Every tool result links directly to the relevant methodology section

capabilities.name: Editable examples and usable templates
acceptanceRows: Every tool has an explicitly labelled editable example with independently calculated expected output
Changing example input changes the live deterministic result
Templates are real portable artifacts and download without login or email
Example/template versions identify their compatible formula and schema revisions

capabilities.name: Factual comparisons
acceptanceRows: Every comparison names observation date, evidence grade and source
Competitor behavior is described factually without invented access, feature or superiority claims
Stale or unverified rows are omitted or visibly marked unavailable
Comparison pages link to the relevant working SoapCraft tool and methodology

capabilities.name: Canonical SEO and public shell
acceptanceRows: Canonical metadata, sitemap, robots and structured data are generated from the route registry
Legacy routes redirect one-to-one only where semantics match and no duplicate /marketing tree is canonical
Gated chemistry is not described in metadata as a currently working public calculator
No retired subscription, CRM or social-campaign route appears in navigation or sitemap
Deployed canonical URLs return expected status without redirect loops

capabilities.name: Chemistry publication gate
acceptanceRows: Production ingredient manifest has authoritative provenance and explicit conflict dispositions
Hand calculations and at least two specialist-calculator comparisons are recorded with explained differences
Any fragrance-limit result requires exact material certificate revision and Category 9 mapping
Named independent domain and safety reviewers approve engine and user-facing copy
PUBLIC_CHEMISTRY_ENABLED defaults off and cannot bypass ingredient eligibility
Release-disabled deployed API returns typed 503 without quantities; release-enabled verification occurs only after receipts

flows.name: Formulate to connected plan
acceptanceRows: Anonymous formulation completes with verified data or fails closed and transfers reviewed context

flows.name: Mold to recipe scale
acceptanceRows: Calibrated or ranged mold result transfers to recipe scaling without false precision

flows.name: Scale to cost
acceptanceRows: Scaled quantities transfer to costing and produce complete or explicitly incomplete economics

flows.name: Cost to wholesale
acceptanceRows: Saleable-unit cost transfers to markup/margin pricing and printable quote

flows.name: Price to event plan
acceptanceRows: One or more priced products produce weighted break-even, target and stock outputs

flows.name: Ready-by to purchase plan
acceptanceRows: Production batches transfer to aggregated stock-aware pack-rounded purchase plan

flows.name: Direct tool entry
acceptanceRows: Every canonical tool completes from manually supplied inputs without prior route or account

flows.name: Share and clean-browser re-entry
acceptanceRows: Versioned non-personal share state validates, opens editable and recalculates in a clean browser

flows.name: Local restore and reset
acceptanceRows: Saved local inputs survive reload; save failure and confirmed reset are truthful

flows.name: Discovery and trust
acceptanceRows: Directory, methodology, metadata and route status agree for all eight tools

flows.name: Editable example and template
acceptanceRows: Verified example is editable and compatible ungated artifact downloads

flows.name: Error recovery
acceptanceRows: Validation, API, save and decode failures preserve safe input and expose recovery

gates.Gate_C: PASS — BUILD_AUTHORIZED for the eight researched public tools on 2026-09-11
gates.Gate_R: PASS — normative product, tool, formula, flow and architecture contracts exist
gates.Gate_A: PENDING — requires literal RELEASE_ACCEPTED after independent deployed verification

requirements.description: Formulation behavior, typed public fail-closed gate, data eligibility, context transfer and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §3 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§3.1, 4–9, 13.1, 14.1–14.5 and 15.

Mold geometry, calibration-only precise capacity, receipt-backed planning range, cut plan, context and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §4 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§5.3, 10, 13.3, 14.7 and 15.
Copy-versus-recalculation behavior, target bases, errors, context and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §5 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§3.2, 4, 9, 10.4 and 13.
Cost basis completeness, saleable yield, currencies, contribution, context and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §6 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§2.3, 3.3, 4, 11, 13.2 and 14.6.

Markup/margin, list/invoice discount and fee algebra, MOQ/pack quote behavior and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §7 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§3.3.2–3.3.6, 11.2–11.7 and 12.2.

Weighted contribution, explicit mix normalization, target-profit, stock scenario and proof behavior are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §8 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§3.3.6, 3.4, 11.4 and 12.1.
Date-only backward capacity allocation, infeasibility, safe wording, context and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §9 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§3.6, 12.3 and 12.5–12.6.
Ingredient aggregation, buffer/stock/pack/minimum/landed-cost rules, currency behavior and proof are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §10 and CALCULATION-SPEC.md §§3.5, 11.7 and 12.4.
Result envelope, context schema, local persistence, secure share, export, editable imports and migration behavior are exactly those in TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §2.
The directory exposes exactly the eight canonical tools with truthful states and verified mobile/desktop behavior as required by PUBLIC-TOOL-CONTRACT.md §§2–3.
Every tool has direct methodology with equations, units, assumptions, limitations, provenance and revision behavior as required by PUBLIC-TOOL-CONTRACT.md §12.
Every tool has editable independently verified examples and ungated portable templates as required by PUBLIC-TOOL-CONTRACT.md §12.
Published comparisons retain observation dates, evidence grade/source and factual working-tool links as required by PUBLIC-TOOL-CONTRACT.md §12.
Canonical SEO, sitemap, robots, metadata and public route behavior derive from the truthful route registry as required by PUBLIC-TOOL-CONTRACT.md §§3 and 12.
Production chemistry evidence and independent authorization satisfy CALCULATION-SPEC.md §15; absence preserves typed public fail-closed behavior.
Formulate-to-connected-plan browser journey behaves exactly as FLOWS.md F-01 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §§2–3.
Mold-to-recipe-scale browser journey behaves exactly as FLOWS.md F-02 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §§2 and 4–5.
Scale-to-cost browser journey behaves exactly as FLOWS.md F-03 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §§5–6.
Cost-to-wholesale browser journey behaves exactly as FLOWS.md F-04 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §§6–7.
Price-to-event-plan browser journey behaves exactly as FLOWS.md F-05 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §§7–8.
Ready-by-to-purchase-plan browser journey behaves exactly as FLOWS.md F-06 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §§9–10.
Direct entry to each canonical tool works anonymously with complete manual valid inputs as required by FLOWS.md F-07.
Clean-browser share and re-entry validate, preserve editability and fail safely exactly as FLOWS.md F-08 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §2.
Local restore, truthful save failure and confirmed reset behave exactly as FLOWS.md F-09 and TOOL-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md §2.
Tool discovery, route registry, methodology, sitemap and truthful availability agree exactly as FLOWS.md F-10.
Editable examples and portable templates behave exactly as FLOWS.md F-11.
Validation, API, local-save and share-decode recovery preserve safe input and expose recovery exactly as FLOWS.md F-12.
One-time Seller Pack payment is excluded from this free public-tool release.
